# Users.au Frontend Client

> JavaScript/TypeScript OAuth 2.0 + PKCE client for Users.au with Vue 3, React and Next.js integrations. npm package `@users-au/client`. Part of Users.au (https://www.users.au), a hosted identity service.

Install / start: `npm install @users-au/client`

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/Users-au/frontend-client/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, usage, troubleshooting and FAQ
- [Users.au](https://www.users.au): hosted authentication service
- [Users.au console](https://my.users.au): create a project and an OAuth application

## Related projects
- [Laravel starter kit](https://github.com/Users-au/laravel-starter-kit)
- [Next.js starter kit](https://github.com/Users-au/nextjs-starter-kit)
- [Laravel client (Composer)](https://github.com/Users-au/laravel-client)
- [Laravel Socialite provider (Composer)](https://github.com/Users-au/socialite-provider)
